## History

Mr. Wace arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as a youthful minister alongside his new wife, filled with zeal for his career and still enjoying their honeymoon. Early in his tenure, he and Mrs. Wace visited the [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) home for a tea party prepared by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). ## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--wace.md)

Wace is the wife of the new local minister and acts as a supportive friend to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally ruins a cake meant for Wace's visit, Wace gently comforts the distraught girl and takes an interest in her flower garden. She subsequently invites [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to tea at the manse, where her continued kindness makes a deep, joyful impression on [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), +11 more_
